verdicts.reason: A is just the original shrunk to fit: the headline, body copy and CTA are all smaller, the bottom ~45% of the canvas is empty, the orange divider has moved up under the eyebrow instead of sitting under the headline, and the legal line is microscopic. B uses the tall format better, with a larger two-line headline, readable body copy and a strong CTA, but its SOLSTICE wordmark is clipped by the bottom of the header (a brand flaw), the gaps between groups are too loose and uneven (the gap from headline to body is huge), and the legal text is too small to read.
